{{Quote|When you come from a planet like Gand, where we've got both ammonia-breathers and oxygen-breathers, you have to be adaptable.|Zuckuss|<ref name="Slave Ship">''[[Slave Ship]]''</ref>}}
'''Gand''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], located in [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]], just beyond the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]], and on the border of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="Atlas" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] species.<ref name="OPF" /> Small [[Pocket colony|pocket colonies]] covered the surface, separated by [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of thick [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]]-gas mists, all of which were ruled by the Gand's long-standing totalitarian [[:Category:Governments|government]].<ref name="FF50">{{FactFile|50|BOU 13-14|Bounty Hunters &ndash; Zuckuss}}</ref> [[Merchant/Legends|Commerce]] and trade were conducted on any of the five [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Space station/Legends|space stations]].<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>

==Description==
A gaseous planet, Gand's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was comprised primarily of [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]], which made it lethal to most [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] lifeforms. 

==History==
At some point, however, the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] had [[Raid on Gand|raided]] the planet prior to the arrival of the [[Exiles]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> Gand was discovered prior to [[3951 BBY]], during the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3668 BBY]], [[Yuun (Gand)|Yuun]] was born on the world.<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The planet remained independent of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The isolated world was not located on any major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] and was not involved in the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trade. Largely overlooked,<ref name="Atlas" /> the planet was later overrun by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], whose agents brought sophisticated sensor equipment on-world, to the detriment of the native [[Findsman/Legends|findsmen]].<ref name="OPF" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Gand remained uninvolved in the affairs, aside from the participation of individuals. In recent years, the planet escaped invasion during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], and had no participation in the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Atlas" />
